podcast.title: Band Origin and Activity (1980-1991)
podcast.body: The Icicle Works, an English group formed in Liverpool in 1980, remained in its first incarnation until 1991, during which period they released nearly two dozen singles. "The Isicle Works, an English group formed in Liverpool in 1980. When their first incarnation together, which lasted until 1991, they released almost two dozen singles."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 50 Biggest All-Time Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders: Part 1

podcast.title: Record Label Interference
podcast.body: The band's American record label significantly intervened with their hit single, demanding a remix, shortening the band's name from "The Icicle Works" to "Icicle Works," and reversing the song's title for the US release. "A remix followed, which removed a spoken word bit in the original. The group's name had to be shortened from V. Isicle Works to just Isicle Works. And for some weird marketing reason, I have no idea why the title was reversed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 50 Biggest All-Time Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders: Part 1

podcast.title: Title and Name Confusion
podcast.body: The various changes imposed by the American label, particularly the reversal of the song title, created confusion, with the song known differently (e.g., "Birds Fly Whisper to a Scream" vs. "Whisper to a Scream Birds Fly") depending on the region. "Maybe all this confusion was why it was a one-hit wonder."
